## Checklist

- [ ] `go mod tidy` has been run and `go.sum` is committed
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test ./... -race` passes
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] Documentation and OpenAPI are updated when the contract changes
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included
- [ ] Migrations are additive and backward compatible
